The Sunhollow Guild main hall at dawn, quiet with only a few early risers, a single figure standing before the quest board — a small boy with silver-white hair in a blue cape, holding a cup of coffee that has stopped steaming, his blue eyes fixed on the new notice, dust motes dancing in the slanted morning light, the fire crackling softly in the hearth
panels.thought: A new dungeon. Genuinely new. In the Whisperwood of all places. I can feel the mana signature from here — it's stable, structured, and complex. This isn't just a cave. It's a formed dungeon.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Lian from behind, the quest board before him, other notices blurring into the background, his silver hair catching the morning light, his hand holding a cold coffee cup hanging at his side, his posture radiating thoughtful stillness
panels.thought: In my past life, I explored dungeons that had existed for millennia. But a new dungeon... that's rare. Dungeons grow and evolve based on the mana they absorb. A new one means unknown layouts, unknown spawns, unknown everything.

panels.composition: Dynamic shot of Nora bursting through the guild doors, her ginger pigtails flying, her green eyes wild with excitement, one finger pointed at Lian as she skids to a halt on the wooden floor, her trainee badge gleaming, her shield already strapped to her back

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: LIAN! I heard! A NEW DUNGEON! We HAVE to go! This is what we've been training for!

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's face, a small smile spreading across his features as Nora's excitement breaks his contemplative mood, his eyes crinkling with warmth and anticipation, the cold coffee cup finally being set down on a nearby table
panels.thought: Nora's enthusiasm is contagious. She's right — this is what we've been training for. And I'd be lying if I said I wasn't excited too.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Finn arriving through the guild door, slightly out of breath, his floppy brown hair more disheveled than usual, holding a hammer that looks newly enchanted — faint brown-gold runes visible along its surface, his expression a mix of nervousness and determination, a smudge of soot still on his nose

dialogue.speaker: Finn
dialogue.text: I came as soon as I heard. If we're doing this... I'm bringing my best work.

panels.composition: Wide shot of the three children standing together before the quest board — Nora practically vibrating with excitement, Finn holding his reinforced hammer with nervous pride, Lian between them with a calm confident smile, the quest notice visible above them, the morning light streaming through the windows casting long golden shadows across the guild floor
panels.thought: The Whisperwood Rangers. That's what Nora named our party. Three kids with a dream, a shield, and a magic hammer. I have a feeling this is the beginning of something unforgettable.

scenes.location: Whisperwood Forest — Deep Woods, Late Morning
narration: The path to the new dungeon took us deeper into the Whisperwood than either Nora or I had ever gone.
Finn led the way, his newly enchanted hammer held ready. He'd never been this deep either, but he refused to show fear.
The forest changed as we went deeper. The trees grew thicker, their bark covered in luminescent moss. The air grew cool and still.
And then we found it. The dungeon entrance.
It wasn't a cave mouth or a crack in the earth. It was a perfectly formed archway of swirling stone — as if the forest itself had opened a door.
Runes I didn't recognize were carved into the frame. Ancient. Predating the current magical era.
I felt a pull. A resonance. Like the dungeon was calling to something inside me.
Nora bumped my shoulder. 'You ready, Lian?'
I gripped my staff. Took a breath. And nodded.

panels.composition: Deep Whisperwood forest path, the trees here are ancient and enormous, their trunks covered in luminescent blue-green moss, thick roots crossing the path like natural stairs, shafts of golden light piercing through the dense canopy, the air misty and cool, ferns and glowing mushrooms lining the way, the atmosphere feeling older and more primal than the outer forest
panels.thought: The deeper Whisperwood is different. The mana here is older, denser, more aware. This forest has been here for thousands of years. It remembers things.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Finn leading the party along the path, his reinforced hammer held in both hands, his hazel eyes scanning the surroundings with alert nervousness, his leather apron over his tunic, a small backpack visible, his jaw set with determination despite the uncertainty in his eyes

Nora walking beside Lian, her shield up but lowered slightly as she peers around with wide-eyed wonder, her freckled face a mix of excitement and caution, her ginger pigtails bouncing with each step, one hand occasionally reaching out to touch a glowing mushroom before pulling back

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: This is so cool! The moss is GLOWING! And the air feels... tingly! Like before a thunderstorm!

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's eyes as he activates Mana Sight, his blue irises shimmering with golden light, the world through his perspective becoming a tapestry of swirling mana streams — the trees pulsing with life force, the ground glowing with underground currents, the air thick with ambient energy that flows like a gentle river
panels.thought: Mana Sight shows me the truth of this place. The entire forest is a network of living energy. And somewhere ahead... there's a concentration so dense it glows like a second sun.

panels.composition: Lian's Mana Sight perspective of the forest path ahead — the mana streams converging toward a single point in the distance, glowing with increasing brightness, the magical signature forming a complex pattern that pulses in rhythmic waves, like a heartbeat echoing through the forest's energy network

Panoramic reveal of the dungeon entrance — a perfectly formed archway of swirling grey-green stone embedded in the side of a massive ancient tree, the arch covered in intricate runes that glow with a soft inner light, the passage beyond appearing as a swirling veil of magical energy, the surrounding trees leaning toward it as if paying homage, beams of light illuminating the arch from above like a spotlight from the canopy
panels.thought: By the stars... I've seen thousands of dungeon entrances in my time. But I've never seen one like this. The architecture predates modern civilization. This dungeon has been here long before Sunhollow existed.

panels.composition: Medium shot of the three children standing before the dungeon entrance, the archway towering above them, its glow casting an ethereal light on their faces, Nora with her shield raised and mouth open in awe, Finn gripping his hammer with white knuckles, Lian with his staff planted and eyes fixed on the runes as if reading a language only he can understand

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: This isn't a normal dungeon. The runes on the arch are pre-Era. This place has been sealed for a very long time.

panels.thought: The runes are ancient. A dialect of Old Magian that hasn't been spoken in three thousand years. The translation reads: 'The deep remembers. The core awakens.'

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian reaching out his hand toward the swirling veil of the entrance, his fingers stopping just short of touching it, a visible spark of energy leaping from the veil to meet his skin, his eyes widening as a jolt of recognition passes through him, the golden light of Mana Sight flaring brightly in his eyes
panels.thought: The moment my mana touched the veil... I felt something. Not a presence, but an echo. Like the dungeon recognized me.

panels.composition: Nora bumping her shoulder against Lian's with a grin, snapping him out of his trance, her freckled face full of eager anticipation, Finn standing behind them adjusting his grip on his hammer, the three of them silhouetted against the glowing archway

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: You ready, Lian? First real dungeon. First real adventure. Let's show this place what the Whisperwood Rangers can do!

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's face, a slow confident smile spreading across his features, the fire of adventure lighting his blue eyes, his small hand gripping his wooden staff, the golden glow of the dungeon entrance reflecting in his gaze

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: Let's go explore a dungeon.

panels.thought: The old sage in me wants to study every rune and catalog every layer. But the five-year-old boy in me just wants to see what's inside. I think I'll let the boy lead this time.

scenes.location: Deep Forest Dungeon — First Floor, Entrance Hall
narration: Stepping through the veil was like passing through a curtain of warm water. The sensation lasted only a moment.
And then we were inside.
The first thing that struck me was the light. The dungeon wasn't dark — it glowed.
The walls were made of smooth crystalline rock that pulsed with soft blue-green veins of light. Like being inside a giant geode.
The air was cool and still, carrying a faint mineral scent. Our footsteps echoed in the vast silence.
Nora whispered: 'It's beautiful.'
Finn whispered back: 'It's creepy is what it is. Beautiful and creepy.'
I didn't say anything. I was too busy feeling the dungeon's mana signature.
It was old. Very old. And it was awake.

panels.composition: Interior of the dungeon entrance hall, walls of smooth crystalline rock in shades of deep grey-blue, veins of bioluminescent blue-green light pulsing through the stone like living pathways, the ceiling rising into darkness with faint glimmers of light far above, the floor smooth and polished as if worn by centuries of use, an eerie beautiful glow filling the space
panels.thought: The dungeon interior is made of crystallized mana residue. This formation takes centuries of stable mana concentration. This place is far older than I initially estimated.

panels.composition: Close-up of the dungeon wall, the crystalline surface smooth to the touch, veins of blue-green light running through it like nerves, tiny sparkles within the crystal catching the ambient glow, the surface subtly warm, the patterns organic and flowing like frozen lightning

Extreme wide shot showing the three children standing in the vast entrance hall, their tiny figures dwarfed by the towering crystalline chamber, the blue-green glow casting their long shadows across the smooth floor, the scale emphasizing how small and insignificant they are compared to the ancient dungeon, their breath visible in the cool air

Medium shot of Nora with her shield raised, turning in a slow circle to take in the vast chamber, her green eyes wide and sparkling, her mouth forming silent words of wonder, the blue-green light reflecting off her shield and casting shifting patterns across her freckled face

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: It's like being inside a treasure chest. A really, really big treasure chest.

panels.composition: Close-up of Finn, his hammer held across his chest defensively, his hazel eyes scanning the shadows at the edges of the chamber, a bead of sweat on his temple despite the cool air, his voice low and guarded

dialogue.speaker: Finn
dialogue.text: Beautiful and creepy. Like a haunted cathedral made of gems.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Lian standing apart, his eyes closed, his staff held loosely in one hand, his head tilted as if listening to something only he can hear, a faint golden aura shimmering around his fingertips, the blue-green light of the dungeon casting his face in ethereal tones
panels.thought: The dungeon has a heartbeat. I can feel it through Mana Sight. Slow. Deep. Resonant. Like an enormous sleeping creature breathing in perfect rhythm.

panels.composition: Lian's Mana Sight view of the dungeon — the walls are not solid stone but a lattice of compressed mana crystals, alive with flowing energy, the entire chamber connected by veins of power that pulse in a complex network, the floor itself a conduit drawing mana from the earth below and cycling it through the structure in an endless loop

Medium shot of Lian opening his eyes, a new understanding in his gaze, turning to Nora and Finn with a calm reassuring expression, the three of them forming a small circle in the vast chamber, ready to move forward

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: The dungeon is stable. The mana flows in predictable patterns. I can sense two paths ahead — one leading deeper, and one that loops back to the entrance. Stay close, stay quiet, and let me guide us.

panels.thought: I can map this dungeon through Mana Sight. The energy patterns reveal the layout like a living blueprint. This is an advantage I didn't have in my past life.

scenes.location: Deep Forest Dungeon — First Floor, Crystal Corridor
narration: The corridor narrowed. Crystalline formations jutted from the walls like frozen fountains.
And then we heard them. Skittering. Chittering. Echoing from all directions.
Mana Beetles. They emerged from the shadows, their carapaces gleaming like polished obsidian with glowing blue runic patterns.
They were the size of dinner plates, with mandibles that clicked with hungry anticipation.
F-rank monsters. But there were dozens of them.
Nora didn't wait. She charged forward with a battle cry, her shield raised.
Finn followed, his hammer already swinging.
I hung back, Mana Sight active, analyzing their movements, looking for the pattern.
Mana Beetles have a hive mind. Injure the lead one, and the rest panic.
I aimed a precise wind blade at the largest beetle's leg joint. It crumpled. The swarm faltered.
That was all the opening the party needed.

panels.composition: A narrow corridor of the dungeon, walls lined with crystalline formations that jut outward like frozen fountains, the blue-green glow pulsing dimly here, shadows pooling in the corners, the path ahead curving out of sight, the atmosphere tighter and more claustrophobic than the entrance hall
panels.thought: The corridor narrows. Good defensive position — they can only come at us a few at a time. But I have a feeling we won't have to wait long to meet the locals.

panels.composition: Close-up of the shadows at the corridor's edge, multiple pairs of glowing blue insectoid eyes emerging from the darkness, the first Mana Beetle stepping into the dim light — its carapace gleaming like polished obsidian with glowing blue runic patterns etched into its shell, mandibles clicking, antennae twitching as it senses the intruders

Wide shot from behind the party showing the corridor ahead filling with Mana Beetles — at least a dozen visible, their blue runes glowing brighter as they prepare to attack, their clicking mandibles creating a cacophony of sound, the children forming a defensive huddle, Nora at the front with her shield raised, Finn beside her with his hammer ready, Lian behind them with his staff glowing
panels.thought: Mana Beetles. F-rank swarm-type monsters. Individually weak, but in groups they can overwhelm larger predators through sheer numbers. Perfect for testing a new party.

panels.composition: Dynamic shot of Nora charging forward, her shield leading, Brave Heart emblem on her hand blazing with orange light as she slams into the front rank of beetles, sending two of them skittering backward, her gap-toothed battle cry echoing in the corridor, her ginger pigtails flying as she follows through

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: WHISPERWOOD RANGERS! FORWARD!

panels.composition: Finn swinging his reinforced hammer in a wide arc, the impact catching a beetle mid-leap and sending it crashing into the wall, the hammer's head glowing with faint brown-gold Earth magic as it connects, splinters of crystal flying from the impact, Finn's expression fierce and focused

dialogue.speaker: Finn
dialogue.text: GET BACK!

panels.composition: Lian's first-person perspective through Mana Sight, a targeting reticle of golden light focusing on the largest beetle in the swarm, a thin line of compressed wind magic tracing from his staff toward the target, the beetle's leg joint highlighted as the weakest point, the surrounding beetles connected by faint red threat lines showing their hive-mind link
panels.thought: Hive mind. The larger one is the anchor. Sever the anchor, sever the coordination.

panels.composition: Lian's wind blade slicing through the air with surgical precision, a thin arc of compressed golden wind, striking the largest beetle's leg joint cleanly, the leg separating, the beetle collapsing with a screech, its carapace runes flickering and dimming as the hive connection breaks

Medium shot of the remaining beetles faltering, their coordinated attack falling apart into confused individual movements, some retreating into the shadows, others milling aimlessly, Nora and Finn standing amidst the chaos of broken beetle carapaces, breathing hard but victorious, the blue glow of the dungeon returning to its steady pulse
Close-up of Nora's face, sweaty but triumphant, her freckled face split in a huge grin, her shield still raised but her posture relaxing, looking back at Lian with pure excitement

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: We did it! Our first real dungeon fight! And we WON! You saw that, right?! I shield-bashed TWO of them!

panels.composition: Medium shot of Finn leaning against the wall, catching his breath, a small proud smile on his usually grumpy face, his enchanted hammer resting on his shoulder, looking at the scattered beetle shells with newfound confidence

dialogue.speaker: Finn
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. The enchantment held up perfectly.

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian kneeling beside a defeated Mana Beetle, his small hand reaching out to touch its carapace, the blue runic patterns fading as the beetle dissolves into motes of light, leaving behind a small pulsing core — smaller than a slime core but with a distinctly different energy signature, the core glowing with an intricate internal pattern
panels.thought: Mana Beetle cores. Different from slime cores — they're attuned to the dungeon's frequency. I could use these for something special. Maybe a resonance-based enchantment.

scenes.location: Deep Forest Dungeon — The Glowing Mushroom Grove
narration: Beyond the beetle corridor, the dungeon opened into a sight that made even me stop in my tracks.
An underground grove filled with giant glowing mushrooms. Bioluminescent fungi that towered above us like trees of light.
Their caps glowed in shades of purple, pink, and cyan, casting the cavern in an otherworldly twilight.
Spores drifted through the air like tiny floating stars, leaving trails of soft light in their wake.
A stream of crystalline water wound through the grove, glowing with its own inner light.
Nora walked into the middle of it, arms outstretched, face tilted up, letting the spores drift around her.
Finn sat on a mushroom cap (it was bouncy) and took a moment to rest.
I just stood there, breathing in the mana-rich air, feeling the dungeon's magic flow through this beautiful chamber.
'This,' I said quietly, 'is why I became an adventurer.'
Nora looked at me. 'I thought you wanted a quiet life.'
I smiled. 'This IS a quiet life. Just with more glowing mushrooms.'

panels.composition: Breathtaking underground cavern filled with giant glowing mushrooms of all sizes — towering specimens reaching twenty feet high with caps in vivid shades of purple, pink, and cyan, smaller clusters carpeting the ground in soft light, bioluminescent spores drifting through the air like floating stars, a crystalline stream winding through the grove glowing with pale blue light, the entire chamber illuminated in an ethereal multicolored twilight
panels.thought: I've seen the Crystal Tower at sunset. The Elemental Planes. The Auroral Gardens of the Northern Wastes. But this... this belongs on that list.

panels.composition: Close-up of a giant mushroom's gills, intricate bioluminescent patterns visible on the undersides of the cap, tiny droplets of glowing liquid forming at the edges, spores releasing in rhythmic pulses, the light shifting through subtle color gradients, the stem covered in delicate luminescent veins

Extreme wide shot of Nora standing in the middle of the grove, arms outstretched, face tilted upward, her small figure surrounded by towering glowing mushrooms, spores drifting around her like a galaxy of tiny stars, the crystalline stream curving past her feet, the scene looking like something from a dream, illuminated in ethereal purple-pink-cyan light

Medium shot of Finn sitting on a large mushroom cap, the surface slightly bouncing under his weight, his hammer resting across his knees, his expression peaceful and relaxed for once, the soft colored light casting his features in warm tones, a rare smile on his face as he takes in the beauty around him

dialogue.speaker: Finn
dialogue.text: Okay. I take it back. Not creepy at all. This is... actually amazing.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Lian standing at the edge of the grove, staff in hand, his face illuminated by the multicolored glow, his blue eyes reflecting the dancing lights, a look of pure wonder and contentment that makes him look exactly like the five-year-old boy he appears to be

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: This... is why I became an adventurer.

panels.composition: Close-up of Nora turning to look at Lian, a quizzical smile on her face, one eyebrow raised, a pink spore having landed in her ginger hair glowing softly, her expression playfully skeptical

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: I thought you wanted a quiet life. Sleeping in. Reading books. Taking naps.

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's face, a soft warm smile spreading across his features, his eyes crinkling with genuine happiness, the glowing mushrooms reflected in his blue irises, his voice carrying the wisdom of an old man and the joy of a child

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: This IS a quiet life. Just with more glowing mushrooms.

panels.thought: I used to think peace meant stillness. Now I know it means moments like this — surrounded by light, by friends, by wonder. The quiet life isn't about doing nothing. It's about being exactly where you're meant to be.

panels.composition: The grove from a high angle, the three small figures of the party scattered through the glowing landscape, connected by threads of soft light between them — not real, but a visual representation of their bond, the spores swirling in gentle patterns around them, the stream glowing like a ribbon of light through the center

scenes.location: Deep Forest Dungeon — Core Chamber Entrance
narration: Beyond the grove, the dungeon changed again. The playful colors faded, replaced by a deep, pulsing amber glow.
The walls became smoother, more structured. Less natural cave, more constructed chamber.
We had found the heart of the dungeon — the Core Chamber.
The door was massive. A circular stone slab covered in runes that matched the entrance arch.
It didn't open by force. It opened by resonance.
I stepped forward without thinking. My hand touched the door. The runes flared to life.
The door ground open, revealing a chamber of impossible light.
At its center, floating in midair, was the Dungeon Core.
A crystal the size of my head, rotating slowly, its surface a kaleidoscope of swirling colors — blues, golds, purples, greens — all shifting in an endless dance.
The moment I saw it, I felt it. A resonance. A connection.
The core recognized something in me. And I recognized something in it.

panels.composition: Transitional corridor leading from the mushroom grove, the bioluminescent colors shifting from playful pinks and purples to deeper amber and gold, the walls becoming smoother and more deliberately shaped, ancient carvings visible in the stone, the atmosphere growing more solemn and sacred
panels.thought: The dungeon's architecture is changing. From organic growth to deliberate construction. We're approaching something important.

panels.composition: Close-up of the massive circular stone door blocking the path ahead, its surface covered in intricate runes that glow with a faint amber light, the runes arranged in concentric rings that pulse in sequence, the center of the door bearing a symbol — a four-pointed star within a circle, the same symbol from the entrance arch
panels.thought: A resonance lock. The door only opens for someone whose mana signature matches the dungeon's frequency. This isn't a barrier — it's a test.

panels.composition: Nora trying to push the door open, bracing her shield against it and shoving with all her strength, her face red with effort, the door not budging an inch, Finn trying to find a seam or gap with his hammer, both of them working while Lian stands motionless, staring at the runes

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: It's not... budging... at ALL! Finn, try hitting it!

panels.composition: Lian walking past his struggling friends, his steps slow and deliberate, his hand reaching out toward the stone door, his eyes glowing with Mana Sight, a look of dawning understanding on his face

dialogue.speaker: Lian
dialogue.text: It's not a door you force. It's a door you speak to.

panels.composition: Extreme close-up of Lian's small hand pressing against the stone door, the runes around his fingers flaring to life one by one, golden light spreading from his touch in concentric waves, the stone vibrating with released energy, his palm glowing where it meets the ancient surface
panels.thought: The door resonates with my mana. It recognizes the Star Sage's signature. But that's impossible — this dungeon predates my original life by millennia. Unless... it's not recognizing Aldric. It's recognizing something deeper.

panels.composition: The massive stone door grinding open, ancient mechanisms awakening, dust and magical particles cascading from the moving stone, a blinding light spilling from the chamber beyond, the runes blazing with golden-white brilliance, Nora and Finn shielding their eyes, Lian standing at the threshold silhouetted against the light

The Core Chamber — a vast circular room with walls of smooth crystalline amber, a single beam of light descending from an unseen source above, illuminating the center of the room where a crystal the size of a human head floats in midair, rotating slowly, its surface a living kaleidoscope of swirling colors — deep blues, warm golds, rich purples, vibrant greens — shifting in an endless hypnotic dance, the floor beneath it carved with concentric circles of ancient runes that pulse in rhythm with the core's rotation
panels.thought: The Dungeon Core. The heart of this place. Every dungeon has one — a crystallized concentration of the dungeon's mana, its memory, its identity. I've seen a hundred cores in my time. But this one... this one feels different.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Lian stepping into the chamber, drawn toward the core as if pulled by an invisible string, his staff forgotten at his side, his blue eyes locked on the floating crystal, the light from the core casting shifting colors across his face, his expression one of profound recognition
panels.thought: The core's energy signature... I know it. But how? I've never been in this dungeon before. Yet my soul remembers. It remembers THIS.

panels.composition: Abstract visualization of the connection — Lian's mana signature (golden starlight) reaching out and intertwining with the core's energy (multicolored celestial light), the two resonating in perfect harmony, creating patterns of light that echo through the chamber like ripples in a pond, the runes on the floor responding with increasing brightness

Close-up of Lian's face, his eyes wide with wonder and something deeper — recognition, belonging, a piece of a puzzle he didn't know existed falling into place, the core's light reflected in his eyes, tears forming at the corners as the resonance overwhelms him
panels.thought: This core... it's made of the same essence as my soul. Star-touched mana. This dungeon wasn't formed by random natural processes. It was formed around something. Something that fell from the sky. Something connected to the stars. Something connected to ME.

narration: We didn't push further. The first floor was mapped, the core located, and we had learned enough for one day.
Back at the guild, Brock listened to our report with growing astonishment.
'You reached the Core Chamber on your FIRST expedition?' he boomed. 'That's unprecedented!'
Nora recounted every battle with grand gestures. Finn showed off the beetle carapace he'd kept as a trophy.
I sat quietly, nursing a warm cup of honey milk, the feeling of the core's resonance still humming in my chest.
Brock gave us each a bonus — five extra silver for 'exceptional initiative.'
Nora spent hers immediately on candy.
Finn bought new leather straps for his hammer.
I held mine in my palm and thought about the core. About the runes on the door. About the strange, magnetic pull I felt.
This dungeon held secrets. And I had a feeling they were connected to who I really was.
But that was a mystery for another day.
Tonight, I was just a boy who had explored his first real dungeon with his best friends.
And that was enough.

panels.composition: The Sunhollow Guild hall in the warm glow of evening, the fire crackling in the hearth, adventurers scattered at tables nursing drinks, the quest board casting long shadows in the dim light, Brock at the reception counter leaning forward with an incredulous expression as Nora gestures wildly recounting their adventure
panels.thought: Back in the familiar warmth of the guild. It feels like we were gone for days, but it's only been a few hours. Time moves differently in dungeons.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Nora standing on a chair to better act out her story, arms spread wide demonstrating the size of the beetles, her voice animated, Brock laughing with his head thrown back, other adventurers gathered around listening with amusement

dialogue.speaker: Nora
dialogue.text: —and then LIAN, with this LOOK on his face, just TOUCHES the door and it OPENS! Like MAGIC! Well, it WAS magic! But you know what I mean!

panels.composition: Medium shot of Finn sitting at a table nearby, a piece of beetle carapace in his hands, examining it with the eye of a craftsman, turning it over to feel its texture and density, a small satisfied smile on his face, a mug of water untouched beside him

Close-up of Lian sitting at a small table in the corner, both hands wrapped around a warm cup of honey milk, steam rising past his face, his eyes distant and thoughtful, the firelight casting warm shadows on his features, the echo of the core's resonance still visible as a faint golden shimmer in his eyes if one looks closely
panels.thought: The core is still humming in my mana. I can feel it even now, miles away. It's not a call — it's an invitation. But to what? And why me?

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's small hand holding three silver coins, the metal warm and gleaming in the firelight, his thumb absently rubbing the surface, the coins reflecting the flames, his palm and fingers still carrying a faint residue of magical energy from the dungeon
panels.thought: Three silver for the expedition bonus. But the real treasure is in the core chamber, waiting. And I'll be back to claim its secrets.

panels.composition: Medium shot of Nora dropping into the seat across from Lian, a piece of candy already in her mouth (a lollipop), her freckled face happy and exhausted, Finn joining a moment later, setting his beetle carapace on the table, the three of them together in comfortable silence, the fire crackling warmly beside them
panels.thought: I became Aldric Starshine by seeking power and knowledge. I became Lian by seeking peace and friendship. But looking at these two — Nora with candy smeared on her cheek, Finn already planning his next craft project — I realize I don't have to choose. I can have both.

panels.composition: Close-up of Lian's face breaking into a genuine, unguarded smile, the warmth of the moment reaching his eyes, the golden shimmer finally fading as he lets himself just be present, just be Lian, just be a boy with his friends after an adventure
panels.thought: The Deep Forest Dungeon holds mysteries I'm eager to unravel. But right now, sitting here with my party, watching Nora try to balance her lollipop on her nose... I'm exactly where I need to be.

panels.composition: The guild hall from a high angle, the three children at their corner table, a warm golden light seeming to surround them, the other adventurers blurred in the background, the crossed sword and staff symbol of the guild glowing softly above the door, the scene feeling like a snapshot of a perfect moment

chapters.title: D-Rank Breakthrough
chapters.summary: Lian's mana naturally matures to D-rank (equivalent of an adult adventurer). Elder May notices and formally offers to mentor him. Their first lesson: elemental fusion — combining fire and wind to create lightning. Lian already knows this but pretends to learn. May knows he's pretending but plays along.

chapters.title: The Star Festival
chapters.summary: A continent-wide celebration of the stars. Ancient magic causes auroras to dance across the sky. Lian feels a deep connection — the stars feel familiar. Nora wishes on a shooting star. Finn awkwardly gives handmade hairpins to a girl he likes. Slice of life chapter.

chapters.title: Rival Village
chapters.summary: A neighboring village challenges Sunhollow to a 'friendly' harvest competition. Lian's team has to gather rare herbs, defeat a mock monster, and create the best magical display. Lian has to balance helping his village win without revealing too much power.

chapters.title: Monster Surge
chapters.summary: A sudden surge of monsters from the Whisperwood threatens the village. Lian takes charge of the defense using clever barrier spells and crowd control. The older adventurers are amazed. Brock offers Lian a formal party leader position. Lian accepts reluctantly.

chapters.title: The Enchanted Forge
chapters.summary: Lian helps Finn build an enchanted forge using fire and earth magic. The forge produces higher-quality tools. The village blacksmith is so impressed he offers Finn early mastery. Finn's confidence grows.

chapters.title: Water Temple Ruins
chapters.summary: The party explores ancient Water Temple ruins. They encounter water elementals, solve magical puzzles, and find a rare Water-attuned monster core. Lian senses the temple was connected to an old civilization — pre-dating the current magic system.

chapters.title: Friends and Farewells
chapters.summary: End of first arc. Nora's family considers moving to the capital for better opportunities. Lian helps her convince them to stay by demonstrating the village is becoming a hub for adventurers. Brock promotes all three kids to F-rank adventurers officially. The village celebrates.

chapters.title: The Guild Exam
chapters.summary: Lian, Nora, and Finn take the official F-rank adventurer exam. Written test, practical test, and a mock dungeon. Lian scores perfectly on everything. Nora breaks a practice dummy. Finn accidentally reinforces a door so well it can't be opened. They pass with style.

chapters.title: The Alchemist's Visit
chapters.summary: A traveling alchemist teaches Lian potion-making using monster cores and herbs. Lian discovers he has a talent for alchemy too. He creates a basic healing potion that works three times better than standard. The alchemist offers to buy the recipe.

chapters.title: Mana Sight Evolution
chapters.summary: Lian's Mana Sight unexpectedly evolves during meditation. He can now see elemental compositions, not just mana flows. He realizes he can copy any spell he sees by analyzing its mana pattern. This is extremely rare and powerful. He tells Elder May.

chapters.title: The Lost Pup
chapters.summary: A young magical beast pup (a Fae Fox) gets separated from its family in the village. Lian and Nora help reunite it. The Fae Fox bonds with Lian and becomes his familiar. Magical creatures are drawn to his mana signature. He names it 'Ember' for its fiery tail.

chapters.title: Ember's Training
chapters.summary: Slice of life chapter about Lian training his new Fae Fox familiar. Ember learns simple tricks, can sense magic items, and has a mischievous personality. Nora is jealous and tries to befriend a grumpy barn cat. The cat ignores her.

chapters.title: The C-Rank Dungeon
chapters.summary: Lian's party attempts their first C-rank dungeon. It's significantly harder — traps, smarter monsters, a mini-boss. Lian has to use real combat magic for the first time (ranked-up elemental spells). Nora discovers her Brave Heart skill evolves under pressure: 'Valiant Charge'.

chapters.title: Cores and Crafting
chapters.summary: Lian experiments with monster core enchanting. He creates a magic lantern that never goes out, a self-heating cooking pot, and a compass that points to the nearest dungeon. He starts selling these in the village. Word spreads to nearby towns.

chapters.title: The Merchant's Offer
chapters.summary: A wealthy merchant from the capital visits Lian. They offer a business partnership: Lian provides enchanted items, they handle sales in the capital. Lian agrees on the condition that the village gets a cut of profits. The merchant is surprised but agrees. Lian is now a young entrepreneur.

chapters.title: Competition Arrives
chapters.summary: A group of young prodigies from the Royal Capital Academy visits. They're arrogant, talented, and spark a rivalry with Nora. Lian has to mediate while also impressing them with 'minimal' displays of magic. The prodigies are humbled. Lian makes potential allies.

chapters.title: The Midnight Visitor
chapters.summary: A mysterious cloaked figure visits Lian at night. They know about his past life. They were a student of Aldric Starshine in his original world. Now an old person, they somehow reincarnated naturally. They came to warn Lian: not everyone who remembers is friendly.

chapters.title: Old Souls Gathering
chapters.summary: Lian learns there are other reincarnated souls in this world — people from his original life who also got second chances. Some are friendly. Some seek power. Some are hiding. Lian must decide whether to seek them out or keep his quiet life.

chapters.title: The Dungeon Race
chapters.summary: A regional dungeon race event. Parties compete to see who can reach the deepest floor in 24 hours. Lian's party enters. They use clever strategies and Lian's mana sight to navigate efficiently. They place second (first is a party of C-rank veterans). Respect is earned.

chapters.title: B-Rank Awakening
chapters.summary: Lian's mana naturally surges to B-rank during a training session with Elder May. She reveals she knew about his past all along — she was also reincarnated, but from a different original world. She was a healer in her past life. 'The universe gives second chances to those who earn them.'

chapters.title: The Crystal Tower Memory
chapters.summary: Lian has a vivid dream of his original life — the Crystal Tower, his students, the wars he ended. He realizes there's one thing he left undone: a spell he was creating to heal the world's mana wounds. He decides to finish it in this life.

chapters.title: Village Growth
chapters.summary: Time skip. Sunhollow has grown from a sleepy village into a bustling town thanks to Lian's enchanting business. New buildings, new faces, a proper guild hall. Lian is 7 now. Nora is 9. Finn is 16 and a master blacksmith. Life is good.

chapters.title: The S-Rank Dungeon
chapters.summary: An S-rank dungeon is discovered nearby — a world event. Adventurers from across the continent gather. Lian's party decides to enter for experience (just the first floor). They see legendary-grade monsters, meet famous adventurers, and Lian senses something familiar deep in the dungeon — a piece of his original world.

chapters.title: Dungeon Resonance
chapters.summary: Deep in the S-rank dungeon, Lian finds a crystal shard that resonates with his mana. It's a fragment of the Crystal Tower — somehow transported to this world during his reincarnation. It amplifies his Mana Sight. He can now see mana across vast distances.

chapters.title: The World's Mana Wound
chapters.summary: Using the enhanced Mana Sight, Lian discovers this world has a 'mana wound' — a crack in its magical foundation. If untreated, it will spread and destabilize the world over centuries. The incomplete spell from his past life can heal it. He finally has a purpose beyond slow life.

chapters.title: Gathering Allies
chapters.summary: Lian gathers his party and tells them the truth about his past life. Nora is shocked, then excited. Finn takes it in stride. Elder May already knew. Brock says he's seen stranger things. They agree to help Lian heal the world. The slow life will have to wait.

chapters.title: The Healer's Path
chapters.summary: First step: find the five elemental convergence points across the continent. Lian, Nora, Finn, and Ember set out on their first real journey. The adventure begins in earnest.

chapters.title: The Fire Convergence
chapters.summary: Journey to the Volcanic Ridge. They endure harsh climates, fight fire-elementals, and Lian purifies the Fire Convergence Point using his completed healing spell. Each convergence point strengthens the world's mana network.

chapters.title: Desert Crossing
chapters.summary: Traveling to the second convergence point in the Great Sand Sea. They encounter a nomadic tribe, learn desert magic traditions, and face a massive sandworm. Nora defeats it with her evolved Brave Heart skill.

chapters.title: The Water Depths
chapters.summary: The Water Convergence is at the bottom of an ocean trench. Lian uses an air bubble spell and wind propulsion to descend. He meets an ancient water spirit who tests his worth. He passes, purifies the convergence.

chapters.title: Sky Islands
chapters.summary: The Wind Convergence is on a floating island. They must earn the trust of sky-dwelling people who control the winds. Finn proves himself by crafting a wind-resistant anchor. The sky people bless them.

chapters.title: The Mountain's Heart
chapters.summary: Deep inside a living mountain, the Earth Convergence is guarded by stone guardians. Lian uses his knowledge of earth magic to pass through without violence. The mountain recognizes him as a 'friend of the deep places.'

chapters.title: Lost in the Stars
chapters.summary: The final convergence — Light — is not a physical location but a celestial point. Lian must align his mana with the stars themselves using the Crystal Tower fragment. He succeeds and gains a deeper understanding of this world's magic.

chapters.title: World Healing
chapters.summary: All five convergences purified. Lian performs the world-healing ritual. The mana wound closes. The world's magic stabilizes. Across the continent, people feel a warmth pass through them. Flowers bloom out of season. The sky glows with gentle auroras for a full day.

chapters.title: The Cost of Miracles
chapters.summary: The healing ritual drained Lian's mana to near-zero. He's bedridden for a week. The entire village takes turns bringing him soup and flowers. Nora refuses to leave his side. Finn brings a get-well-soon hammer he enchanted himself.

chapters.title: Recovery and Recognition
chapters.summary: Lian recovers. News of the world-healing miracle spreads. Representatives from the capital arrive to honor him. He's offered a position at the Royal Academy. He politely declines — he has a slow life to live. But he accepts an honorary title: 'Star-Touched Sage'.

chapters.title: A New Normal
chapters.summary: Life returns to normal. Lian goes back to enchanting, exploring, and spending time with friends. But now the world knows his name. Travelers visit Sunhollow just to see 'the Star-Touched Boy.' Lian finds it embarrassing. Nora finds it hilarious.

chapters.title: The S-Rank Test
chapters.summary: Lian's mana peak reaches A-rank, but S-rank requires a unique test: facing one's inner self. Lian confronts a magical construct of his past self — Aldric Starshine. He must prove he's not bound by his past. He passes and becomes an S-rank mage at age 9.

chapters.title: The Other Reincarnated
chapters.summary: Other reincarnated souls from Lian's original world begin to gather. Some are good. One has been corrupted by power and wants to dominate this world. Lian must confront them — not as enemies, but as a teacher helping them find their way.

chapters.title: Teaching Old Souls
chapters.summary: Lian establishes a small school near Sunhollow for reincarnated souls struggling to adapt. He teaches them to find peace in their new lives. Nora becomes his assistant. The school becomes famous as a place of healing and second chances.

chapters.title: The Corrupted One
chapters.summary: Lian confronts the corrupted reincarnated soul. Instead of fighting, he offers understanding. The corrupted one was once his friend in the original world, twisted by regret. Lian helps them heal. No battle — just compassion.

chapters.title: A Growing Family
chapters.summary: The school grows. The village thrives. Lian turns 10. Nora turns 12. Finn becomes a master smith with his own forge. Elder May passes away peacefully, leaving Lian her journals and staff. Lian mourns but understands — she completed her journey.

chapters.title: The Star Festival Again
chapters.summary: A year later. The Star Festival returns. Lian watches the auroras with Nora and Ember. He reflects on how much has changed. He's no longer just a boy from a village — he's a symbol of hope. But to his friends, he's still just Lian.

chapters.title: Nora's Evolution
chapters.summary: Nora's unique skill evolves again — from 'Valiant Charge' to 'Valiant Heart.' She can now share her courage with allies as a buff. She's becoming a true party leader in her own right. Lian couldn't be prouder.

chapters.title: Finn's Masterpiece
chapters.summary: Finn creates his masterpiece: a legendary hammer infused with earth, fire, and light magic. The hammer chooses its wielder. It chooses Finn. He becomes the youngest master smith in the kingdom's history.

chapters.title: Ember's Growth
chapters.summary: Ember the Fae Fox evolves into a nine-tailed form after absorbing ambient mana near a convergence point. Ember can now speak telepathically with Lian. Their bond deepens.

chapters.title: The Dungeon Below
chapters.summary: A massive dungeon is discovered directly beneath Sunhollow. The village was unknowingly built on a dungeon cap. The party must clear it to prevent it from breaching the surface. The dungeon is tied to the world's original creation.

chapters.title: World's Core
chapters.summary: At the bottom of the dungeon, they find the World Core — the heart of this world's magic system. Lian can see the entire planet's mana network. The Core recognizes him as a world-healer and offers him a choice: become the World Guardian or remain a free soul.

chapters.title: The Choice
chapters.summary: Lian almost accepts the Guardian role. But Nora yells at him: 'You deserve to live YOUR life, not serve a planet!' Lian realizes she's right. He rejects the role. The World Core accepts his choice and seals itself, awaiting another candidate.

chapters.title: Celebration
chapters.summary: Huge celebration in Sunhollow. Lian's choice to stay free is celebrated as a victory for living one's own life. Brock promotes the entire party to B-rank. Lian sees Nora's smile and knows he made the right choice.

chapters.title: The Academy Invitation
chapters.summary: The Royal Academy sends a personal invitation from the king: come teach for one semester. Lian accepts — it's a chance to share knowledge. The catch: he'll be teaching professors, not students. He's nervous but excited.

chapters.title: The Professor
chapters.summary: Lian at the Royal Academy. He's the youngest teacher in history. He teaches 'Mana Theory and Elemental Fusion.' His class is packed. He proves that age doesn't determine wisdom. He makes friends among the faculty.

chapters.title: Academy Friends
chapters.summary: Lian meets other prodigies at the academy. A shy water mage girl. An arrogant prince who needs humbling. A librarian who suspects Lian's secret. Slice of life school arc.

chapters.title: The Prince's Challenge
chapters.summary: The prince challenges Lian to a duel to prove the 'child prodigy' is overrated. Lian accepts and wins without using any advanced spells — just perfect fundamentals. The prince respects him afterward and becomes a friend.

chapters.title: Secret of the Stars
chapters.summary: Lian discovers the academy library has a sealed section with books from his original world. Someone else reincarnated and left knowledge behind. He finds a message from Elder May: 'Live well, old friend.'

chapters.title: Semester's End
chapters.summary: Lian finishes his teaching semester. He's awarded an honorary doctorate. The students throw him a farewell party. He returns to Sunhollow with new friends, new knowledge, and a deeper understanding of his place in the world.

chapters.title: Reunion
chapters.summary: Homecoming. Nora tackles him in a hug. Finn pretends to be cool but gives him a new enchanted staff as a welcome-home gift. Ember curls around his shoulders. Lian is home.

chapters.title: The Seed of Stars
chapters.summary: Lian plants a magical seed given to him by the World Core. It grows into a 'Starlight Tree' — a tree that produces mana crystals instead of fruit. The village now has a sustainable mana source. Lian's enchanting business booms.

chapters.title: Dragon Sighting
chapters.summary: A young dragon is spotted near Sunhollow. Panic ensues. Lian investigates and finds a baby dragon with a broken wing. He heals it. The dragon's mother is grateful and offers a scale as thanks — a legendary enchanting material.

chapters.title: The Great Dungeon
chapters.summary: An ancient mega-dungeon opens for the first time in 1000 years. Adventurers from across the world gather. Lian's party enters. The dungeon is a journey through the world's history — each floor is a different era.

chapters.title: World History
chapters.summary: Lian sees the history of this world through dungeon illusions. He learns that reincarnation is this world's natural cycle — souls are reborn until they complete their growth. He understands his purpose: he was brought here to heal, not just the world, but himself.

chapters.title: Dungeon's End
chapters.summary: The party reaches the dungeon's final floor. The reward is a 'Wish Crystal' — a one-time item that can grant any wish within natural law. Lian keeps it for emergencies. The party emerges as legends.

chapters.title: Whispers of War
chapters.summary: Tensions rise between two kingdoms. Lian is asked to mediate as a neutral third party. He uses his wisdom to broker peace, preventing a war before it starts. His reputation as a peacemaker grows.

chapters.title: The Peace Summit
chapters.summary: A formal peace summit. Lian speaks about the value of second chances — drawing from his own experience. The two kings shake hands. Nora whispers: 'You did it. You stopped a war with WORDS.' Lian smiles.

chapters.title: A Quiet Birthday
chapters.summary: Lian turns 12. He asks for a quiet birthday — just close friends. Nora, Finn, Ember, and Brock have a small picnic on the hill overlooking the village. Lian feels complete. This is the life he always wanted.

chapters.title: The Gift
chapters.summary: Lian creates a permanent Starlight Barrier around Sunhollow — a gift to the village that raised him. The barrier gently repels monsters and promotes plant growth. The village becomes a sanctuary for all.

chapters.title: Nora the Knight
chapters.summary: Nora is officially knighted for her contributions to dungeon exploration and monster defense. Lian forges her knight's badge himself — enchanted with Brave Heart resonance. She cries. He pretends not to notice.

chapters.title: Finn's Forge
chapters.summary: Finn opens his own legendary forge in Sunhollow. Adventurers travel from across the continent to commission weapons from him. He becomes known as 'Finn of the Sunforge.' His first commissioned piece: a staff for Lian.

chapters.title: School of Stars
chapters.summary: Lian formalizes his school for reincarnated souls into the 'School of Stars' — a place where anyone with memories of another life can find peace and purpose. It becomes a renowned institution.

chapters.title: The Wanderer Returns
chapters.summary: The first reincarnated soul Lian helped returns to thank him. They've built a life — a family, a career, happiness. Lian realizes this is his true legacy: not power, but peace.

chapters.title: The Celestial Alignment
chapters.summary: A once-in-a-century celestial alignment. Magic is amplified across the world. Lian climbs the Starlight Tree at its peak and feels the universe's mana flow. He reaches S-rank — the pinnacle. But more importantly, he feels at one with the world.

chapters.title: A Letter from the Past
chapters.summary: A sealed letter arrives, written by Elder May before she passed. It reveals she was his mother in his original life — also reincarnated, watching over him. 'I couldn't raise you then. I got to this time. I'm so proud of you, my son.'

chapters.title: The Truth of Rebirth
chapters.summary: Lian processes the revelation. He mourns, then celebrates. Elder May was his mother. She watched him live twice. He plants a Starlight Flower on her grave and promises to live well.

chapters.title: Time Moves On
chapters.summary: Montage of years passing. Lian grows from boy to young man. Nora becomes a captain of the guard. Finn marries. The village becomes a town. The school produces graduates. Peace reigns.

chapters.title: New Students
chapters.summary: A new generation of children with strange unique skills enrolls at the School of Stars. Lian recognizes their potential. He becomes a teacher — just like his original life. But this time, the lessons are about life, not power.

chapters.title: Nora's Confession
chapters.summary: Nora confesses her feelings to Lian. Awkward, heartfelt, perfectly Nora. Lian is surprised but realizes he feels the same. They agree to take it slow. Finn pretends he didn't hear but gives Lian a thumbs up.

chapters.title: First Date
chapters.summary: Lian and Nora's first date: a picnic at the Whisperwood's hidden meadow (the one they discovered as kids). They talk about the past, the present, and the future. Nora asks: 'Do you ever miss your old life?' Lian: 'Not anymore.'

chapters.title: The Festival of Stars
chapters.summary: An annual festival is established in Sunhollow — The Festival of Stars, celebrating the world's healing. Lian watches from the hill with Nora, Ember curled at their feet. Fireworks shaped like constellations fill the sky.

chapters.title: Ember's Farewell
chapters.summary: Ember, now ancient and wise, feels her time coming to an end. She spends her final days with Lian. Before passing, she transfers her essence into a small crystal — a familiar core. If Lian ever needs her, he can call her spirit. A tearful goodbye.

chapters.title: The Core of Magic
chapters.summary: Lian studies the familiar core Ember left. He discovers he can manifest her spirit temporarily using mana. Ember's voice echoes in his mind: 'I'll always be with you, partner.'

chapters.title: Twenty Years
chapters.summary: Lian is 25. Nora is 27. They're married. Sunhollow is a prosperous town. The School of Stars has branches in three kingdoms. Lian is known as the Star-Touched Sage — a legend in his own time. But to his family, he's just Lian.

chapters.title: The Next Generation
chapters.summary: Lian and Nora have a daughter — a silver-haired girl with freckles and bright blue eyes. They name her Stella. Lian holds her for the first time and whispers: 'Welcome to this wonderful world.'

chapters.title: Stella's Awakening
chapters.summary: Stella, age 5, awakens her unique skill: 'Starlight Sight' — identical to Lian's Mana Sight but evolved. She can see not just mana but the emotions tied to it. Lian realizes: the legacy continues.

chapters.title: Teaching Stella
chapters.summary: Lian teaches Stella magic the same way Elder May taught him — with patience, warmth, and cookies. Nora watches with a fond smile. History repeating itself in the best way.

chapters.title: The Old Sage's Wisdom
chapters.summary: Lian, now in his 30s, writes down everything he knows — his original life, his reincarnation, his journey — in a book called 'The Star-Touched Chronicle.' He leaves it in the School of Stars' library for future generations.

chapters.title: Nora's Goodbye
chapters.summary: Nora, now an elderly woman, passes peacefully holding Lian's hand. She lived a full, adventurous life. Her final words: 'It was a great adventure. Thank you for being my partner.' Lian holds her and lets the tears fall.

chapters.title: Life After Love
chapters.summary: Lian lives another decade after Nora. He's old, wise, and content. He watches Stella grow, become a great mage, and have children of her own. The cycle of life continues.

chapters.title: Finn's Passing
chapters.summary: Finn passes at an old age, surrounded by his apprentices and family. Lian gives the eulogy: 'He was the best blacksmith I ever knew. And an even better friend.'

chapters.title: The Final Lesson
chapters.summary: Elder Lian, now 80 in his second life, teaches one final class at the School of Stars. A student asks: 'Sage, what's the most important magic?' Lian smiles: 'The magic of living a good life.'

chapters.title: Star-Touched Legacy
chapters.summary: Lian's great-grandchildren run through Sunhollow. The Starlight Tree still blooms. The barrier still glows. Lian watches from his porch, a warm cup of tea in his hands, Ember's crystal around his neck.

chapters.title: The Call Home
chapters.summary: Lian feels his time approaching. He's not sad — he's grateful. He gathers his family one last time. He tells them stories of his original life. They listen with wonder. 'I was a sage once. But being your grandfather... that's the greatest title I've ever had.'

chapters.title: Starlight Eternal
chapters.summary: Lian passes peacefully, sitting under the Starlight Tree, a gentle smile on his face. As his soul rises, he sees Nora, Elder May, Ember, and old friends waiting. The stars above Sunhollow shine brighter than ever. A new child in the village awakens their unique skill — Starlight Sight. The cycle continues. In the School of Stars, a young student reads Lian's book and looks up at the sky with wonder. The Star-Touched Boy is gone. But the stars remember. And the story never truly ends.
